headline: Mastercard (MA) Launches A Richer Citi AAdvantage Executive World Legend Card
summary: Mastercard (NYSE:MA), Citi and American Airlines launched expanded benefits for the Citi /AAdvantage Executive World Legend Mastercard. The refresh introduces broader lounge access, higher rewards accrual, travel credits and upgraded hotel and car rental perks. The card now sits on Mastercard's new World Legend benefits tier, aimed at frequent American Airlines travelers in the premium segment.
